opening.argument: The video directs viewers through a paid BitClub membership presented as access to shares in profitable Bitcoin mines and later investment pools. The enrollment screen shows a total of 0.36623261 BTC, approximately $99, and identifies “Purchase shares in profitable Bitcoin Mines” as a membership benefit. The speaker confirms the cost: “It costs 99.90 USD.” This is followed by operational payment guidance: “here you can transfer bitcoin to your blockchain wallet process of transfer wallet of the blockchain here is the process.” The page then displays “Pembayaran Diterima” (“Payment Received”), and the speaker connects the completed account to investments in pool 1, pool 2, or pool 3. The video therefore encourages participation in a paid mining-income opportunity rather than merely discussing or criticizing one.
